issue.title: Reword Reference Note follow-up-work phrase for area-or-project containment
issue.description:
## Memory update

- **Path:** `glossary/reference-note.md` (and optionally `glossary/project-note.md`)

The Reference Note strand says a reference note "gathers source links, notes or highlights, and any follow-up work." Under the new Area Note containment rule (every `#task` belongs in exactly one area or project note by residence; a reference note keeps only its own `^ref` task), follow-up tasks belong in an area or project note, not in the reference note. Reword that phrase so the strand no longer contradicts the containment rule (e.g. follow-up work is tracked elsewhere / linked, not housed, in the reference note). Optionally add an `[[area-note]]` back-link from `project-note` so the note-type family reads both ways. Do not touch any other strand; closing still requires explicit user permission plus `sase memory init`.

task_type_fields.proposed_change: Reword 'gathers source links, notes or highlights, and any follow-up work' so follow-up tasks live in an area or project note and the reference note keeps only its ^ref task; optionally add an [[area-note]] back-link from project-note.

issue.creation_reason: New Area Note strand makes area-or-project residence the rule, leaving the Reference Note wording contradictory; filed per approved plan 202610/area_note_glossary_term.md step 4.
